product_metadata.title: 250 Pieces Christmas Light Clips Plastic Gutter Clips for Hanging Outdoor Lights, Outdoor Gutter Light Clips for Outside String Lights
features: Package: Includes 250 pieces of gutter hang hooks, enough used to hang decorative lights that create a festival atmosphere on Christmas.

Extensive use: Christmas light hooks are used to hang many kinds of lamps and light strings. You can place these clips on indoor and outdoor walls, railings or trees, and hang light strings on them. They are great holiday decorations that can create a sense of holiday atmosphere. Suitable for Christmas, Carnival, Halloween and other festivals.
Material: Made of solid plastic, of good quality.
Dimension: Each gutter hook measures 1.2”(L) x 1”(W).

Variety Holiday Decoration: Phedrew offers many type of holiday decoration, such as Christmas wreath hanger, stocking hanger, Christmas tree skirt, Christmas wine bottle cover, Christmas ball storage box, etc. Please visit other Christmas decoration in Phedrew store if you need.
